metadata.description:
In the dense forests of Abujhmar, a massive security operation is underway as central and state forces intensify their offensive against Maoist rebels. But caught in the crossfire are the indigenous tribal communities, whose lives, livelihoods, and freedoms are under threat. Main Bhi Bharat traveled deep into the remote villages of Abujhmar to bring you an unfiltered ground report — capturing the voices, fears, and resilience of the tribals who are often forgotten in this conflict.

Watch as we uncover the human cost of this war — beyond the guns and uniforms — and shed light on the real struggles faced by the people of Abujhmar.
